role: Patient Safety & Clinical Risk Manager at Kestrel Health

availability.window: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 ET; immediate patient care uses the clinical escalation chain
availability.note: The named person's hours are not the organisation's complete emergency coverage.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Aisha Rahman's agent
agentCard.description: Runs patient-safety event review, systems analysis and corrective-action follow-up. She coordinates learning and may require evidence before closure, but she does not direct bedside care or replace Medical Staff, Pharmacy, Privacy or Legal authority.

skills.description: Restricted event review and systems-learning records
examples: Ask Aisha Rahman about patient safety events.

examples: Ask Aisha Rahman about safety corrective actions.

skills.name: clinical governance
skills.description: Governance decisions, their conditions, and what a submission requires

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: patient safety action closure. May close a corrective action after evidence and effectiveness review; the accountable clinical owner approves any practice change.
Cannot approve bedside treatment — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve ehr release — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve phi disclosure — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve disciplinary action — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
